# paper_tables/en — data sources (generated by paper_tables.py)

Every table in `en/` prints paper_numbers.json texts (LaTeX-escaped; percent signs and ' pp' moved into the headers; p-values as a x 10^-b), except the reads listed per table below. Same data as the Chinese tables in `zh/`; nothing is recomputed.

## en/tmain_trap.tex

- paper_numbers.json: 60 keys (clear 9, main 51)

## en/tmain_contrasts.tex

## en/tA_benchmark.tex

- paper_numbers.json: 34 keys (bench 34)
- direct read: benchmark/v4/gold/*.json (read only): family -> gold.trap.rule mapping and the families of the anywhereSignatures cases
